causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: The false indication of a need to constrain operation following the commencement of a planned network outage between Armidale and Coffs Harbour was the most significant factor in the price exceeding $5000/MWh on 22 October 2007.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: This constraint was violated between 8.05 am and 9.55 am.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: On 22 October, this constraint reduced the limit into New South Wales across QNI to around 100 MW, almost 1000 MW lower than its nominal capability of 1078 MW.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Munmorah unit three (300 MW) and Vales Point unit six (660 MW) were both offline for the day.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Eraring unit two (660 MW) was offline from midnight with a forced outage.

constraints_named.quote: The constraint N>>N-NIL_DF_1, which had the most significant impact on dispatch, did not accurately represent the capability of the network, unnecessarily constraining operations.
This was driven by a different system normal constraint (N^Q_NIL_B 1).
